note: Three adjoining loops (Bucks, Cutthroat, Trapline) beside the Flat Tops Wilderness boundary near the Trappers Lake Outlet trailhead, ~9,700 ft (Blanco RD, White River NF). From Meeker: CO 13 east 1 mi, Rio Blanco CR 8 39 mi, then Trappers Lake Road (FSR 205) 10 mi. Trappers Lake is in the wilderness: no motorized boats or wheeled boat carts. The reservable Shepherds Rim loop is a separate entry. --Claude
summary: FS pages for Bucks/Cutthroat/Trapline + the White River NF 2026 operating-dates table: confirmed FCFS-only, potable water, dump station, $22-25. Added 35 sites (10/14/11) and max 36 ft, season (June 2 - Sept 2 / Oct 20), water caveat for Trapline, weekday/weekend rate note, fees checked 2026. flags: Phone: none stored. Blanco Ranger District, 220 East Market St, Meeker, (970) 878-4039 (White River NF offices page). Suggest 970-878-4039.
Site count: 2026 table 10 + 14 + 11 = 35; the per-loop pages (last updated June 6, 2025) say 10 + 14 + 13 = 37 (Trapline 13). Recorded 35.
Water: Trapline's page says 'Potable water is available at this site' but the 2026 table's Water column is 'N' for Trapline (Y for Bucks and Cutthroat).
Toilets: the pages say only 'Restrooms: Yes'; vault_toilets (from the old note) left as stored, not re-confirmed.

Split rule: no split. On NAIP the three loops adjoin one spur road west of FSR 205 (Bucks, Trapline and Cutthroat centres within ~300 m of each other), sharing the complex's dump station. Shepherds Rim is id 2374 (recreation.gov 234795), not re-verified here. A fourth loop SW of Cutthroat on the same spur may be Horse Thief (recreation.gov 10352163, 7/60’, reservable): not this entry.

Pin 39.9945,-107.2372 sits by FSR 205 at the small loop north of Bucks (the Outlet trailhead area), ~200 m from Bucks, ~320 m from Trapline and ~420 m from Cutthroat (FS coordinates). Under 500 m; consider moving it to Trapline's FS point 39.993358,-107.240686, central to the three loops.

Road: the FS gives only directions (CR 8 39 mi, FSR 205 10 mi); no surface or RV wording. The White River conditions page and alerts list nothing for FSR 205 or CR 8 (Blanco's 5/5/2026 note: 'County Road 8 (North Fork): This road is now open from Meeker, CO to Yampa'). Removed the unsourced 'gravel' from the note. The 2026 season has ended for all three loops (Cutthroat's estimated close 10/20).

Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept: on NAIP the nearest water is a pond/arm ~90-140 m east of the Bucks loop and a small lake ~130 m north of the road, both screened by dense conifers; Trappers Lake proper is ~600+ m SE. The North Fork White River is 400 m+ away (NHD). No open apron from any loop.
